words.example: The overrun from room B is pushing our three o'clock meeting back.
words.exampleZh: B室超时占用，把我们三点的会往后挤了。

words.example: Leave a ten-minute buffer time between those two interviews.
words.exampleZh: 那两场面谈之间，请留出十分钟缓冲时间。

words.example: Please allow twenty minutes of travel time between the two sites.
words.exampleZh: 两个院区之间，请留出二十分钟路上时间。

words.example: Build in fifteen minutes of setup time before the all-staff meeting.
words.exampleZh: 全员会开始前，请留出十五分钟布置时间。

words.example: Cleanup in the auditorium has to finish before the evening clinic.
words.exampleZh: 礼堂的现场清理必须在晚间门诊开始前做完。

words.example: The cellular failover is a metered network, so large updates wait until fiber returns.
words.exampleZh: 蜂窝备用线路是按流量计费的网络，大更新会等到光纤恢复再下。

words.example: Delivery optimization let nearby clinic PCs share the May update instead of each pulling it.
words.exampleZh: 分发优化让旁边的门诊电脑互相传五月的更新，不用各自去拉。

words.example: Peer cache on the ward subnet served the viewer package to PCs that missed the push.
words.exampleZh: 病区子网的对等缓存把阅片安装包给了没接到推送的电脑。

words.example: Branch cache at the east campus kept the policy files local after the WAN blip.
words.exampleZh: 广域网抖了一下之后，东院区的分支缓存仍把策略文件留在本地。

words.example: The content server in building C holds the viewer package for that campus.
words.exampleZh: C 座的内容服务器放着这个院区的阅片安装包。
